# comms-mcp

Unified fleet comms gateway: Telegram Bot API v0.1 behind the `comms_ops`
portmanteau (send/read_recent/list_threads/status/help). Allowlist-gated
send, sanitized inbound, 7-day retention, SQLite outbox.

- Full docs: [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt)
- Repo: https://github.com/sandraschi/comms-mcp
